verdict.rationale: Semgrep Supply Chain explicitly determines reachability by checking whether vulnerable code patterns are actually present/called in the codebase, flagging findings as reachable vs unreachable, which lets security engineers prioritize by real exploitability rather than just manifest presence. This is documented as a core mechanism (dependency inventory + rule-based reachability analysis) directly addressing the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of reachability accuracy and noise-reduction claims beyond vendor docs.
